title: Full-Day Toledo Tour with Cathedral from Madrid
description: Known to some as the city of three cultures—because of its Muslim, Christian, and Jewish heritage—Toledo is a stunning medieval city that's an easy day trip from Madrid. Take a trip to this UNESCO World Heritage Site with this guided group tour, complete with round-trip Madrid transportation. After easy coach travel, enjoy sights like the old city walls, 12th century synagogue, and Primate Cathedral of Saint Mary—all included.

placeList.title: Synagogue of Saint Mary the White

reviews.usertext:
Very well organised from beginning to end. The guide (Serinna???, forgive me for forgetting) was engaging and very well informed. Obviously there is an awful lot to spin Toledo so this tour gives a very good overview. Entrance to all monuments was included in price - synagogue, cathedral, church of the lord of Ortega to see the Stunning El Greco.

Once you arrive in Toledo at the bottom of the hill it is walking all the way - a long way. About 6 klms according to the guide and it’s a very hilly town so be prepared for a work out and wear sensible shoes as the streets are medieval cobbles and uneven.

There is 25 minutes break about 12.30 then not another break until 2.30. Take advantage of the opportunity to use bathrooms when you can.

Bus returns you to Via Grande.

All in all a good day out. Bu

Our tour guide was fantastic! She was enthusiastic and genuinely wanted to answer everyone’s questions. We got a good amount of free time to explore on our own and proper breaks. Although, I wouldn’t recommend this tour for younger kids because there is a lot of walking and thorough explanations of the monastery and history of the city. I found it enriching to learn about it with my father though.

A great day out from Madrid, would highly recommend!

Our guide, Christina, was both friendly and informative. The tour itself well organised and helped make it a really enjoyable day out.

Toledo itself is a must see, and I would recommend taking the full day trip option as this allows enough time to get lost in the side streets and shops - to expedience the full charm of Toledo in your own time.

My only feedback would be that it is a shame the whole group wasn't divided into smaller groups for the walking tour, as it was logistically challenging to navigate the narrow winding streets in such a large group and whilst still benefiting from the points of interest Christina showed us (although we could still hear hear the commentary via our personal audio sets).

As a tip to other travellers, I would suggest walking to the second meeting point on Calle San Barnado - rather than Plaza Mayor. As meeting at Plaza Mayor essentially results in having to walk with a guide to the second meeting point and joining the back of the long queue!

This is my second trip with Fun and Tickets this holiday and would definitely recommend.

The tour guide was phenomenal and should not be discredited for their exceptional knowledge and energy to keep a whole group energised for a whole day in 44 degree heat.

I was under the impression this was a fairly small tour group however it was in fact quite a large group. This ultimately felt like a greedy tour company trying to squeeze as many people on to the tour bus and tick off a few sites along the way.

I’ve never experienced a tour size this large (even in walking tours) and I definitely would never waste the money again.

The trip to Toledo was worth it however my advice would be to just book with either a small private tour or find your own way there then pay for the tickets to the sites, individually.

Majority of this tour was just waiting on other people to catch up to the group and bathroom brakes. There was very little time spent in the actual historical sites.

I didn’t stay there for a night but if I had my time again, I would have at least a day or two to really immerse the scenery and get lost in the small cobbled streets. It’s quite a romantic town so having the time to enjoy it without hordes of tourists would have been more enjoyable too!

Arantxa was a good guide, but she should not have had to take the whole bus on her own in both languages. It was unfair for the tour and the guide. Her method of guiding was to say one sentence at a time in both languages. Which for me was boring to hear and understand everything twice but for my fiance who only speaks English, he could barely understand since he didn't know when to focus on what she was saying. If she translated a paragraph at a time instead it would have been better. The tour was beautiful, but we had a very inconsiderate couple who made us wait for them and made us late 2 times because they can't keep track of each other or time. We waited an hour total for them to be found because only one of them has a phone and they separated at some point. It was annoying and not the guides fault but at a certain point I would have left them. It was ridiculous and there's trains that go back every hour so holding up 40 other people was not cool at all. All in all, fun and tickets should give arantxa help so she can focus on one language and make it easier for guests to enjoy the visit. She works really hard to make sure everyone is enjoying themselves and translating back and forth.

Keep your money. The guide knew his stuff but was disconnected from the group only reciting information. The church was nice but not worth a half day with so much in the city. A return train is ~€20-25 and it would be better spent with so many things to do. The wait time for the El Greco painting in the church did not justify the hour spent there waiting to enter them waiting in the church only to find out that the wait was a 3-4m move forward before exiting. The walk through the city was interesting because of the connected and interwoven history of the cultures but, again, wandering the streets to stop in small alleys with only high walls instead of areas to see the architecture was just terrible. In the same amount of time I could have done the Synagogue, the Cathedral, Hercules caves, the ruins, and the garden.

The tour guide did the best she could with an impossible task: doing the tour in both Spanish and English. First a sentence (or a clause, or two sentences) in Spanish, then in English. It was very difficult to follow and undoubtedly shortened the explanations and descriptions the guide could give. When asked to provide an English tour and promising customers an English tour, that is what the tour operator should provide. It may be that there were an insufficient number of English speakers for a full tour in this day, but the operator should be able to address that other than by lessening everyone’s experience. In addition, the online ticket I received from the operator did not specify a time to be at the meeting place other than the start time of 9 AM. When we showed up at 8:45 the group had long since left our meeting place. (The operator was able to book us in another tour.). So the operator needs to remedy what I view as its administrative deficiencies.

This was our 2nd of three tours with Fun and Tickets and just an average experience. The entire trip was bilingual with information first presented in Spanish and then in English. The guide's English skills were OK, but not nearly as good as the guide the previous day to Avila and Segovia. My daughter speaks Spanish fairly well and said that the information provided in English was not nearly as complete as what was given in Spanish.

Like the other tours with Fun and Tickets, we had radios with earbuds to listen to the guides along the tour. The earbuds are EXTREMELY uncomfortable and was one of two negatives for this tour. The earbuds are not returnable, I'm sure due to sanitary reasons, but I still find this very wasteful. Due to the fact they are so uncomfortable, I recommend you take your own headphones or earbuds (with a plug, not bluetooth).

The other issue with this tour is that it is advertised as a full-day tour but the actual tour time is only 2.5 to 3 hours. We didn't arrive in Toledo until 10:30 a.m. and our guide released us to two hours of free time at 1:30 p.m. After we gathered again at 3:30, we returned to Madrid.

The organization of the trip from and to Madrid and the guide were very good. However, at the end of the tour, when we had some free time (1.30h) we had to eat McDonalds food, on the street, because every single restaurant had huge queues and we didn’t had enough time to wait. Other than that everything was fine.
My advice to the company is to recommend in advance a lunch and offer the possibility of the table reservations. (List of restaurants or at least time of the lunch break so people could reserve a table in advance).
It’s a pity that we couldn’t enjoy in local food while we were in Toledo.

Not as advertised. Firstly, our guide was very good and tried hard in difficult circumstances. However, the advertised offering was a tour with groups of UP TO 15 persons. We had 53 people in our group. This meant that as much time was spent doing multiple head counts as we did in actually touring. The large numbers made the tour very, very slow and laborious, and even more so given the nearly 40 degree heat. Thirdly, with such large numbers of people in the group, if you were towards the back of the group as we moved around you were so far away from the guide that the audio guide the tour guide was transmitting g through was out of range so there was no information being received. Fourthly, the tour was advertised as English speaking, however it was actually bilingual, which made the day even longer, which was already oppressively slow due to the large numbers, and difficult to follow. Between audio dropping out, bilingual translations coming through sporadically, the heat and ridiculously large tour group numbers, almost impossible to get any information about what we were seeing. As I said, our guide tried her best and spoke clearly in Spanish & English during the times we could get reception. Will be contacting the tour group directly for a refund for false advertising given the advertised maximum groups of 15

Irene was our guide for this trip and she was so knowledgeable! Her English was pretty perfect and she made the trip interesting and enjoyable. It's hard to engage a group of people but she managed to keep our interest with relevant and historical details for each stop of the way. If she didn't know something she'd try to look it up but she never made anything up or skipped questions. A+ and 5 stare for Irene

The bus was a little cramped though. I would've liked a nicer bus. C+ for the bus, no rhyme intended 😊

This tour is for you if you just want to check Toledo off your list with minimal planning, otherwise it might be better to go yourself and find a walking tour that starts in Toledo.

The guide was very nice, spoke good english and did the best she could with the group, but the tour itself is not great.

Issues
1. Massive group - you do the whole walking and monument tour with everyone on the bus, 50+ people with only one guide.
2. Bilingual tour - normally not a problem but this means the explanations takes 2x the time, which coupled with a big group means a lot of wasted time. I felt that the tour could have been a lot better in one language, more time for the guide to give us info and stories about the city.
3. Radios have a very short range, definitely not enough for a group of 50+! I saw mentions of this in other reviews so was prepared and made sure to stick as close as possible to the guide to be able to hear her speak.

We went on the Avila and Segovia tour with the same company the next day, and that one was 10 times better - smaller group, monolingual tour, more information about the cities and sights, made the Toledo tour feel so much worse in comparison.

The low point was the pick up - in a dingy street, very dirty, puddles of water, and huddles of tourists waiting in a cold wind. Registration time is 30 minutes before the bus arrives.
We were taken round the main sights of Toledo with stops for coffee and lunch. The cathedral in particular is truly amazing and we could have had longer there compared to some of the less impressive sights. Our guide was perfectly charming and helpful but her commentary switched between Spanish and English without warning and her English was so accented that it sounded like Spanish. So when she had started in English we missed quite a lot because we thought she was still speaking Spanish! If you can afford it you might want to hire a private guide.

This is my personal opinion and does not necessarily reflect the views of my employer.

I have been on many bus tours in different counties over many years. And this one really delivered.

Staying in central Madrid it was easy for me to get to and from the tour bus pickup point. The coach was clean and comfortable though there was no WiFi on my tour bus and there was no rest room on board either. But I had a good mobile signal everywhere I went and there were sufficient opportunities for using the rest rooms once we reached Toledo.

Our tour guide Arantxa was great and nothing was too much trouble. For instance she was meticulous in making sure no one got left behind after stops during the tour.

After seeing an excellent panoramic view of the City of Toledo the bus dropped us off so that we could walk up to Toledo.

A welcome surprise was a series of escalators which made the initial walk up to Toledo much easier than I had expected.

Even so I was glad that I had bought comfortable shoes along as there was a fair amount of walking throughout the day. When moving between sites I found that there were some easy to moderate slopes on partly cobbled streets.

This tour was narrated in both English and Spanish and I personally had no problem with this or with the tour guides English accent.

The first stop was a “technical stop”. A nice way of saying time it’s an opportunity for the rest rooms and buying a snack!

The first monument of the day was the very impressive Gothic Cathedral which houses many treasures.

And here our guide Arantxa’s in depth knowledge of the history and the subject matter came to the fore. For me she had the best description ever of “So, what is Gothic anyway?”.

After this we stopped for lunch. There was sufficient time and lunch was fine.

But as with all his tours the clock is always ticking and I found that setting a count down timer or alarm was invaluable so that I was not late back.

Next up was the Santo Tome Church with the famous El Greco painting.

The final stop was the Synagogue of Saint Mary the white.

The pick-up was at the far side of a lovely bridge after a carefully designed decent from City.

We got back almost exactly on time.

In summary I got to visit all the major sights in Toledo in one day and didn’t have to think about organising the trip. Both the tour guide and driver were excellent and did all the hard work for us.

And so I have great memories of a Terrific tour of Toledo.

Recommend.

Would highly recommend this tour to those who want to experience Toledo in a day. Arantxa was our guide - she narrated the history of some of the Cathedral paintings and fixtures in both Spanish and English with such ease. The pace of the tour was just nice. We had ample time to take pictures, listen to the narrations, have lunch, and soak into the scene.

Excellent day with our tour guide Arrantoux. She has been lively, friendly and talked on the historical aspects very well.
Competitively priced tour I will highly recommend this for everyone who is new to Spain and learn about Toledo old capital of Spain

We love the Toledo Tour! The city has an interesting history dated back to the Vickins time. It has stunning views where you can capture beautiful pictures. The only suggestion I will provide is that they shouldn’t do the English and Spanish Tour together because it takes time away from either speakers groups to keep looking around the city. Otherwise, the tour guide Rafael was very nice and patient with our big group and knew all the history of the city and its main places. My favorite place was the cathedral. I had never seen a church like that. Thank you!

A great value way to visit Toledo with the ease of pick up and drop offs right in the city centres. The drive is easy and takes one hour on the motorway.

The walking tour was included in the cost and our guide was delightful. The tour was for 1 1/2 hours but didn’t work out like that as it stopped at each of the key monuments. This was the only issue because unless you paid the additional €30 for entrance costs you were left to wait outside. The walking tour, therefore, included stopping at the monuments rather than completing the tour and then people choosing to go inside the various monuments.

A good experience with a good driver and a fun and friendly guide.

Our tour took place on a Wednesday with our guide Arancha. There were approximately 15-20 people in our tour. The bus ride was very comfortable, the wifi worked but was slow. There is no toilet on the bus, and you are not allowed to eat or drink on the bus. There are bathrooms and food and drink near the meeting point before your tour begins. Toledo was beautiful. The tour covers about 5 km of walking on stone streets and half of that is uphill so wear comfy shoes. Arancha was very good. During the entire tour she would speak Spanish for one sentence, then repeat in English. It was easy to understand, the head phones worked well as long as you didn't linger too far behind. She has great knowledge of the subject and appears ro genuinely like her job. I believe everyone in the group enjoyed the tour. Some, who were tired near the end, wanted it to end a bit sooner, but all and all even they said they really enjoyed their day. It was hot but we were able to walk in shade most of the time. We had 90 minutes for lunch (not included for the price) and free time. Carry some water and sit during most stops and you will have a great time. I had been looking forward to seeing Toledo for several years and I was not disappointed.

Christina looked after us really well. We even had an assistant guide bringing up the rear, so nobody got lost. Very lovely city. Good for those keen on marzipan, fine damascene handicrafts and swords. Although, how you would transport swords through the airport, I 'm not sure. The Tagus river valley and bridges are very picturesque as are the town gates that are in different styles. The cathedral is a must see, as is its sacristia and museum. If you're keen on El Greco that's a good place to go. The Plaza de Zocodover is a great place to have a beer and a bite to eat. We used it as our meeting place. The tour didn't include the alcazar, but we were given ample private roaming time to explore it ourselves.
Nearly all my criticisms of my previous Sagovia and Avila tour were acted upon. Well done Fun & Tickets folks! Still need a better transmitter/receivers system so that the guide can be heard as she goes round the corners of the tight alleys and roadways.
But all in all a very enjoyable day.

Rafael was punctual, courteous, knowledgeable and did a fantastic job teaching and entertaining our mixed tour group of 22 people on a motor coach, from babies to elders. Highly recommend this day tour, and don’t skip on the cathedral entrance. The stop at the lookout was a great opportunity for photos. There was also a good amount of time for snacks, shopping, and exploring this magnificent city.

Toledo is a wonderful place to visit . Tour was well organized and the tour guide Esperanza was very enthusiastic and knowledgeable. However switching between English and Spanish is somewhat distracting as almost all were English speakers . Smaller tour groups of 8-12 are usually better and conducted in a single language

This tour was just the right amount of knowledge-sharing and walking for us, who traveled with teens, preteens, and adults. Aranxta was an excellent guide, very knowledgeable, and managed to present the information clearly in both English and Spanish. We were able to see many of the important monuments, included in the price, without feeling overloaded by art and history. The tour was a hit with all of our party.

our guide, raphael, was great. the tour advertised going into The Synagogue of St Mary the White. We walked there and we were told it was closed due to construction. Operator must have known this and did not disclose. Guide took us to another synagogue and upon arrival were told this one is also closed. We went to Iglesia de Santa Tome to view a beautiful painting but we were not admitted into the church which i believe is misleading. When we were done with our visit of the Cathedral of Toledo we were walked outside and told we had an hour and 45 minute break. I wish we were given the option to stay in the church. once outside we had almost 2 hours and could not go back into the church. The tour of the Cathedral was great, but very rushed and it would have been better to spend time on one's own to view it at their own pace and pray or light a candle. After this we walked up a hill to view a corner of the Alcazar, which we had already seen from a previous overlook, and told we could not enter because it is closed on Mondays (which it was). The next day at the Prado I learned there is an El Greco museum in Toledo. I wish we had visited that instead of walking all around to buildings we could not enter, or been told of the museum before our break so that we could use our 1hour 45 minutes to see it.

In enjoyed being in and seeing Toledo. As for the tour itself, I must say that as an English speaker, I missed a great deal of what the charming tour guide had to say. My sense is that she was well-informed but not altogether clear when speaking English. (I also believe that her explanations in Spanish were far longer, and therefore, more informative than those in English.)
Of course, the big cathedral is a landmark, but I think we spent more time than was necessary inside. Much of the guide's information and presentation was lost on me and on other folks on the tour, partly because of ambient noise in the highly crowded space. I would like to suggest reducing the number of different sites to see inside the cathedral.

Toledo is amazing and the whole day was interesting but the best was the Cathedral. Maybe a little bit more time to dedicate to it. Our tour guide Arantxa was fantastic she spoke both English and Spanish switching from one language to the other very quickly and easily. The only thing we did not like that much was that we were too many people all together, two smaller group had been better for us and her.

We did the half day tour of Toledo with Arantxa and it was great. She was knowledgeable about Toledo and was interactive with the group. Unfortunately the mic/receivers that the group was using was going in and out but she worked through the technical issues and used her voice during the times when the mic would go out. We had a 25 min coffee break and an hour/ hour and 15 min lunch break/time to explore. The tour was definitely worth it. Would recommend

Our tour guide Oscar was excellent and had very detailed knowledge of all the sites including the cathedrals and the city itself. He had very good English and gave the perfect amount of information enough to appreciate the sites. Very well run tour and easy to understand. Some free time over lunch and souvenir shopping which was great as other tours didn’t provide time to shop. This was a beautiful city and romantic city to visit as a couple with panoramic views and many photo opportunities at lookouts.

Make sure you try the traditional deserts on this tour the mazapan! The yamos is a bit sweet. Overall we rate this tour 6/5 as the scenery of the town was very picturesque and we were thoroughly engaged and impressed with the guide the whole time. Must do tour!

Our guide was very knowledgeable and spoke in two languages: English and Spanish to help the large group. We all had personal headsets to hear her comments. She kept a good pace and took us through all the main sections of the city. I would recommend wearing a good pair of shoes for going up the cobblestone streets. It was very hot and she did a good job of finding shade and places to stop for a few moments. I went with my mom who has a little trouble walking and she was able to keep up - in the end we walked about 5 km.

Toledo is a beautiful city filled with history and beauty. I enjoyed everything about this tour.
The tour guide was very friendly, upbeat and took good care of us with lots of stops and staying in the shade as it was very hot.
I highly recommend this tour as it is a day well spent enjoying beautiful architecture and artwork.

Very nice tour. We got the 6 hours tour and finally it lasted 8 hours with no extra cost and at the end we realised we could use another 2 hours to go around the city.
Toledo is a great place to visit. The city, the history, the little stores, even the food was good.

Don’t miss the cathedral tour. Having visited many cathedrals around Europe, I thought I could skip this one, but Arantxa our guide told us it was worth it, and we are grateful for that. This is a very special cathedral, almost a museum. Must see!

We would like to thank Arantxa, our guide, she is great. Full of energy, taking care of everything, knows very well what she is talking about, always smiling.
Thank you!

Our guide Arantxa was fantastic, and the tour itself was surprisingly doable even with a four year old. Make note that buggies might be a bit hard to handle on the slopes and brick streets of Toledo, though we noticed that many places on the tour were barrier free. Though the walk and heat was a little tiring for my child, there were two breaks in between to rest, eat and shop, which was great. The bus ride was very comfortable and air conditioned, and overall, compared to the hassle of getting to and from Toledo and Madrid using public transportation, and planning the places to tour in a city like a labryinth, this tour was amazing, and well organized. Arantxa was very enthusiastic, and her descriptions in Spanish, English and Italian was very clear and easy to understand. Lucky for me, all the members of the group made sure to be punctual so the time schedule went very smoothly. Hope we can do another tour in another destination sometime soon!

We had a great day on this tour with our guide, Arantxa. Everything went as planned with a comfortable bus ride, beautiful sightseeing and a full day guided tour of the famous sights including the synagogue, main cathedral and a former mosque. The artwork was noteworthy with paintings by El Greco and Caravaggio to name just two! I definitely recommend this tour. Our gracious guide made it all come alive! It is very good value!

Lovely tour guide. We only really saw four places. We saw a synagogue, the Jewish quarter, spent an overly I long period of time with an El Greco painting commemorating the death of the count of Orgaz. Great painting but not such a great explanation, and we went to the cathedral of Toledo where we spent most of our time. My problem was much of the time was counting and recounting all the folks on the tour which made the pace rather slow. The ear buds we were given to hear the tour more clearly were rather uncomfortable. But the city is very historic and worth a trip.

Great tour! Loved the view from the valley + the guide explained everything in both spanish and english. It was a workout given that we were on our feet almost all of the time whilst we were in toledo and there were some really steep slopes but our guide chose mainly areas that were covered and gave ample rest time. I would have preferred more free time at the various sights or monuments to take photos and to roam around though but would still recommend!

Arantxa, our tour guide, was very knowledgeable and pleasant during the tour of Toledo. The transitioning between Spanish and English during the tour made it a challenge to pay attention the whole time even though she did it well. The size of the group was too big for me (40-50) considering the size of venues and streets. I like a small group. I would recommend the guide but would want the smaller tour.

amazing place to visit very worth it, make sure you get confortable shoes. If visiting in september, go comfortable since it might be really hot. our tour lady aranxta is very well prepared and made the day very interested
the church is a most, amazing paintings with historical and religious riches
will recommend to friends and family

Taking a day to visit Toledo is worth the time. The guide was knowledgeable and could tell and show many things in limited time. We had a good day.

Some things to be aware of; the city is built on a mountain with many narrow, angled streets. You will walk quite a distance so make sure you wear good shoes.
The tour is done with a receiver and earphones. Audio did break a few times due to distance or interference. So it's best to stay close to the guide.

Toledo is a lovely city and the guide seemed knowledgeable, unfortunately I was able to hear less than 10% of her comments! The audio for this tour is provided by small devices you wear around your neck with the absolute cheapest in-ear earbuds. This audio system is totally incompatible with hearing aids. If you were hearing aids you will not be able to hear anything. If I took out my hearing aid and tried to use their earbuds I couldn’t understand the audio (it was way underpowered and muffled), and with my hearing aid I had no ability to hear the audio unless I stood right next to the guide. Even then she has a very soft voice which is very difficult to hear, and flittered to the next stop so quickly I could keep up. It was a very frustrating day, especially for my wife who had to try to repeat what the guide said. Seriously, if I had a warning about the audio I would have brought my own “over the ear” headphones so I could hear. Or provide an alternative to people with hearing aids. Or better yet upgrade the decade-old technology and get an Audio system that broadcasts over Bluetooth or wifi so people can use their phones and own audio devices. While I experienced the beauty of Toledo, the tour part was frankly terrible.

Toledo is an important city in many ways - people, history, art and culture and this tour covers it all. Arantya was our guide and she is a natural leader who brings incredible knowledge and passion to her work. She brought the history and art to life with her great storytelling abilities. She made it fun and informative. I highly recommend the tour and hope you get Arantya as your guide!

Our tour guide was amazing. Truly knew her information on the different sites we visited, while also providing additional information on Toledo that we would not have known if we had just gone ourselves. She was passionate about what she was talking about and really insightful. Highly recommend.

Very informative tour! Lots of walking on cobble stones so wear appropriate shoes. Tour guide also gave a lot of important information on the artwork found in the cathedral. Very comfortable bus but ear phones very uncomfortable. Mine kept slipping out out of my ears and they have no foam, just plastic. Good idea to have your own ear pieces if you want them to fit comfortably. Overall, a wonderful tour.

It was indeed an excellent trip & very well explained by our tour guide Mr Oscar. He has presented every minutest detail right from the inception of the fort and also about Emperor Charles the v Th. The Arabic era, Jewish era and Roman era were very well explained. The paintings of ancient times were terrific and maintained very well. Overall it was an excellent experience.

Arantxa (our guide) did a great job with narrating the tour in both Spanish and English. The walking tour offers the opportunity to hear and see not just the major tourist sites in Toledo, but also to learn about the history of the Iberian Peninsula from the Romans, to the Visigoths, to the Moors, and through the Reconquest. As a city that was important for Christians, Jews, and Muslims, Toledo represents a must-see entry on any list of things to do while in Madrid.

This is an a absolute must do if you are in Madrid for a couple of days. Toledo is an absolute gem of a city with so much beauty, architectural marvel and history packed all into one place.
The day starts at a designated pick up point near Gran Via in Madrid at around 8:45 and we were dropped back at 5pm. . It’s an hour journey to Toledo. Headsets are given right before entering Toledo. We loved walking through the old alleyways with so many picturesque spots. You get a break for lunch and shopping at different points of the trip. The peak moment for me was the “Santa Iglesia Cathedral”. It is absolutely breath taking and I honestly was so overwhelmed by the beauty and intricate details there.
Our guide, Arantxa was very informative and patient. She did such an amazing job!! I learned a lot about the city and found it to be a very enjoyable experience. Highly highly recommend this trip. My wife and I loved it. 10/10

PS: wear comfortable shoes as you will be walking quite a bit on this tour.

Arantxa was a great guide. The tour took us across the city of Toledo and exposed us in a short time to understand and see some of the history, architecture, art, and society of this amazing city. The only regret is not having allocated more time during our trip to Toledo, so consider a longer stay in this city. If you are short on time, this tour is perfect

Great way to see Toledo. Our guide, Arantxa, was awesome. Her bilingual skills were impressive, her English was good. Bus was very comfortable with seats that had USB ports for charging. The itinerary was perfect. We had lunch at Gino’s and loved it.

Great tour of Toledo!

A fabulous day - Toledo deserves a full day, I’m glad I chose this tour instead of the two or three cities in one day tour, or travelling solo to Toledo by train.

On time departure from Madrid on a clean, comfortable coach. Fabulous tour of Toledo by our wonderful guide, Oscar, who spoke excellent English. We were given audio sets so could easily hear even if weren’t close. Oscar spoke passionately about everything we saw, and has a huge knowledge of the history of Toledo, the Cathedral, the Synagogue, the art work and carvings within. The tour was conducted in Spanish and English, and he switched between.

We were lucky to be in Toledo just before Corpus Christi, and could admire the beautiful decorations.

I’d considered catching the train and going solo to Toledo but definitely made the right decision to do this tour.

Definitely recommend this tour!

The tour guide was excellent - very nice and knowledgeable. The bus was very nice. We booked a half day (5hr) but I guess they combined us with the full day (8hrs) group which was ok but longer than we wanted. We were very unhappy with being charged an extra 30euros (15ea) for the cathedral tour when tickets at the ticket office next to the cathedral were only 3 euros. The advance tkt didn’t save any time since there was no line and for a couple extra euros you can get headphone with recorded tour. If you do this tour DON’T pay extra for the cathedral tour. Just get the tkt at the window by the cathedral

Arantxa was an amazing tour guide, explaining all the details and history behind each main architecture and artist. It was a dinamic, informative and fun tour. I recommend this tour for those who wants to explore Toledo.

Wonderful guide. Great knowledge, great walk through Toledo and Cathedral. Be ready to walk Long distances uphill and downhill across the city. We stopped at a good place to rest at the middle of the day. Arantxa was very kind to everyone from the beginning, always with a smile, and taking charge.
At the start of the tour, it was a bit confusing when trying to check in. I suggest a bit more of organization for that. While the guide was trying to get things together on paper and on phone, people would come to her to ask her so many questions when she wasn’t ready to answer just yet; however, she handled the moment very well, and with a smile and very politely asked the travelers to please wait until she was done. Again, not the customers fault either. We were just confused of what was going on in the beginning and how we were going to go about the trip. I suggest to form a line against the wall.. or two lines, one against the wall and the other one along the sidewalk, so we’re just not in a messy cluster in the middle of the sidewalk. But then, all preparations were done and we were on our way.
Bus was very comfortable, nice drive as well.
We only ran into a small issue by the end. The toilets we were supposed to use by the end were close and we couldn’t properly use some business’ restrooms. We had to walk a bit more to find toilets at some other restaurants, but we had to purchase something.
There were some public toilets walking distance but one of them you have to 50 cents, so make sure you bring change.
All in all, it was a great walk, great tour, great information, great treatment, great pictures, just be prepared to walk. Bring comfortable shoes, water, and plan ahead for toilets just in case.

Wow! If you are lucky enough to get Aranzca as your guide you are in for a treat! Her sparkling personality and amazing knowledge of Toledo will keep you learning all day long! You will walk about six kilometers and lots of hills and cobblestones so wear comfortable shoes. There is not much down time and this company does not force you into shops or certain restaurants which we liked. Her planning is so good that our group always got in to visit the sites first so we never felt crowded. Whether she is teaching you about art, history or architecture she will keep you informed and entertained. You will love her! One tip - we booked with this company twice and got to the meeting point early. Don’t be late because they will leave, but you don’t need to be there 30 min early either. Overall a fantastic day!

We had a wonderful time during our full day trip to Toledo. Our guide was very well informed and she spoke both fluent Spanish and English. The trip involves quite a bit of walking, would suggest wearing comfortable shoes. A day trip to Toledo is a must when you visit Madrid.

On time. Clean bus. Wonderful and knowledgeable guide. She has fun helping people and brought life to her tour. Walking tempo was exceptional due to two baby strollers and a wheel chair. Great choices for lunch no one got lost and our group was complimented for being quiet and orderly at the painting of El Greco. Our guide called us her family and cultivated warm friendship with each client.

Enjoyed the tour to Toledo. Our tour guide Aranxta was wonderful. She took the time to go over the details, explained the paintings by Greco which was wonderful to learn about. Not to miss the cathedral tour

Must see when in Madrid/Spain. We booked the tour while a 5 day trip to Madrid/Barcelona. Toledo was definitely the highlight, and our guide, Arantxa, was polite, knowledgeable, and patient. The day trip is highly recommended - hope you enjoy the history and culture of a city older than most places you’ll ever visit.

The tour company was excellent, the bus comfortable, and the process was easy.

The tour guide was incredible!
She is just incredibly knowledgeable…best tour guide from any tour I have ever taken in any country!
She had names, places,people, facts, history all memorized! She was also well-dressed, cute, charming, energetic, considerate of things like needing to go to the restroom, asking us to wait in the shade during breaks she had planned our trip very well. She reminded my wife and I of Dora The Explorer 😊
I did not initially want to do this trip because of the hot weather but the experience on this tour changed my mind. I would have regretted missing it.

Thank you…and may you find yourSELF in this life 😇
Hugs,
- A Self-Realized One

Our tour was full of unforgettable experience because we walked through and stopped in several places with exquisite masterpieces and architecture. Our tour guide Arantxa was extraordinary, friendly, and knowledgeable. She is fluent in English and Spanish.

I was a history major and still work on history-related projects. Our guide was not only knowledgeable, but enthusiastic about sharing the history of Toledo and the amazing works of art. She also took great care that the group stayed together. And being a bilingual tour, gave me a chance to work on my grasp of Spanish. Would do this tour again.

It clearly states on the description of this tour that it would have a maximum of 15 people. I assumed that the 52 of us loaded on a bus would break up into small groups. That was not the case. I asked the guide if I was on the wrong tour but she had my group of 4 listed on her tour and said this was the way they were always run. I showed her the listing and she took a picture of it. We were herded through the narrow streets like cattle. The description also said English guide. She said everything in Spanish & English which took so much more time. We walked with Christina, the guide back to the bus and my husband asked her if our friend could get on first as she got car sick on the way. Christina said, “everyone has to take the same seat, I’ll give her a bag in case she gets sick” WOW. Worst tour experience I’ve ever encountered.

My wife and I had a wonderful tour in Toledo. It’s a must see place. Our guide, Arantxa, was excellent. She was very knowledgeable, gave us a deep understanding of the culture, history, and art in the town, the cathedral, temple and mosque we visited.

The tour of Toledo from Madrid was amazing. The mini-bus that picked us up was clean, comfortable and modern. Our tour guide, Arantxa, was an expert on Toledo's history and culture. The walking tour around Toledo included all the major churches, houses, landmarks and the El Greco museum. Arantxa was friendly and made us feel like part of her family. I highly recommend this tour along with an outstanding tour guide, Arantxa.

I booked this trip and I was glad I did. We met at Calle San Bernardo and checked in with our tour guide Arantxa. She was very cheerful, friendly and kind. She put everyone at ease. We boarded our bus which was clean and modern, with USB ports for charging your mobile phones. We had a brief stop-over on our way for a photo-op and the city of Toledo as backdrop. We even had a group picture at the initiative of Arantxa, and she sent the picture to us. Jose, our tour driver took the picture. He was an excellent driver AND photographer! :D Thank you, Jose!

We went through the different parts of Toledo as outlined in the details of the tour. The highlight is the Toledo Cathedral. Everywhere we went, Arantxa did an excellent job explaining the sites/monuments/buildings/structures. She was very knowledgeable and she gave us details and information clearly in both Spanish and English. She gave us ample time for lunch so was able to eat Spanish paella despite 30-minute cooking time.

I highly recommend this full day tour of Toledo with the Cathedral included. Thank you, Arantxa for a very enjoyable and memorable trip to Toledo!

It was annoying having to listen to two languages the entire day to explain everything. We were led to believe this was an English only tour. Also the guide had poor English pronunciation, and spoke in a childish way. The guide kept losing people, and again it was very annoying to have to wait around for the stragglers. Finally the bus on return to Madrid was sweltering hot.

Tour guide was friendly and engaging. The schedule gave some flexibility for time to get food and souvenirs. Overall the tour was very informative, some uphill walking but not too exhausting, and offered some great views of the city and cathedral.

Our guide was cheerful and pleasant but unfortunately the group was so large that we felt rushed when we actually got to our destination. It took us 30 mins to just all go to the bathroom! We wasted so much time as she tried to direct the large group.

We understood the tour was an English tour but it was Spanish and English so we only heard half as much as we could have. We thought she had so much more knowledge than she was able to share.

The head phones are awful. I have not seen that type for 5 or more years! We spent a lot of time getting everyone to hear the guide. A lot of people gave up listening because of the sound and switching between English and Spanish.

This group should have been split into two groups - one in English and 1 in Spanish.

These issues were not the fault of the guide. The company did not set her up to be successful.

Great experience with whole family (including younger children). Aranca was a very good tour guide, speaking both Spanish and English, with great energy and enthusiasm. Learned a ton of history about Toledo and its most prominent structures. Highly recommend for anyone staying in Madrid with an extra day.

Easily the best tour I’ve been on. Our tour guide, Arantxa, was so passionate and informative! She made every site 10x more beautiful with her narration and descriptions. We got to see the Jewish quarter, several mosques, a guided tour of the Cathedral, plazas, and a 360 view of the old city. There was a lot of uphill walking, but totally doable with a comfortable pair of shoes. The tour ended with free time to have lunch and buy some souvenirs. Totally recommend this tour, the city is so so beautiful.

Toledo is a must see city and you must go if you are in Spain. The city and Cathedral are stunning. More importantly our guide Arantxa was muy bien! She was professional, attentive, informative, looked after the group and spoke multiple languages during our tour, which was amazing to hear. Must see your with a must see guide; I highly recommend.

We really enjoyed this tour. Rafa, our guide, was very knowledgeable, and I felt he provided the right amount of detail about the sights. It wasn't overwhelming, but he was able to answer many follow up questions from people who had them. The pace of the tour was relaxed but not dragging, and I enjoyed the time at the end to be able to have a leisurely lunch. It is important to know that lunch is not until the very end of the tour, so you should eat a decent breakfast. The only negative thing that I would say was confusing was that there was supposed to be an escort from the ticket office to the bus-boarding area at 8:15 am, but the person didn't show up until around 8:40, causing some stress about missing the bus, as well as confusion about whether we were in the right place. You are probably better off skipping the ticket office and just meeting at the bus-boarding area.

Good experience.
The guide is really kind and nice, and we can walk the town easily. You can go to some photogenic places.If you go to Toledo first time, I would recommend this tour as you can walk through main places easily.

Arantxa was our guide and she is wonderful. She is friendly and knowledgeable (Five stars). She was the guide for the Avila/Segovia tour before the Toledo tour. In Toledo, we visited a synagogue and the second largest church in Spain and walked the narrow streets learning interesting information on the way. The views were amazing. We had time to eat and look around on our own too. I preferred the Avila/Segovia tour, which included the aqueduct, city walls, and Alcázar; these were more interesting sites to visit for me than the ones on this particular Toledo tour.

Arantxa expertly navigated the streets of this UNESCO city. I definitely recommend a tour guide as the streets can be quite confusing. The tour included the chapel, synagogue, and museum. Arantxa is great at keeping the group moving along while allowing plenty of time for breaks, snacks, and shopping. This tour is great to see as much as possible of Toledo in a day .

Great tour! Our guide Oscar was very knowledgeable & informed. He would explain everything fully in English and then switch to Spanish. He passed out audio devices and disposable earbuds and I was able to hear Oscar at all times. I am sadly unilingual but quickly got used to his accent & enjoyed his descriptions.
The large tour bus was comfortable with about 30 people on a hot August Monday. Toledo was not too crowded with other tourists, although we did see other tour groups. On this full day tour, we did a lot of walking. we had one 30 minute break and later a 70 minute lunch break. Oscar would explain where and how we would go, informing us of toilets & meeting places.
Oscar described the history and culture of Toledo and showed how that formed the neighborhoods and churches, synagogues & mosques. Oscar really knew his art & architecture. I especially enjoyed the tour of the Cathedral.
I look forward to visiting Toledo again.

Since many of the participants spoke Spanish it seemed like most of dialogue was in Spanish. While I am impressed with the tour guide’s knowledge I only understood a portion of what was presented. I should point out that our tour guide was a VERY pleasant person.

We had a great day with our guide, Christina! The meet up was simple and easy to find, the bus ride was comfortable, and we thought the day's schedule was the perfect mixture of guided tours and free time. The radio/headphones system is genius, and allowed us to hear the interesting information that Christina shared throughout the day. I definitely recommend stopping for beer and lunch at La Abadía. We had a really great day and would definitely recommend this tour to everyone.

Arańzazu was excellent! We had a great day and tour to Toledo. She educated and entertained us, and we felt it was well worth the time and money. It’s a beautiful day trip from Madrid…a nice change of pace from the big, crowded city!

Arantxa was an excellent tour guide, knowledgeable, kind, and well organized. Toledo is fascinating and we were glad to have visited. However this company needs to make some changes. The headphones were horrible and much time was spent with people struggling to get them to work. Having the guide repeat every sentence in Spanish and English was tedious and detracted from what could be learned. I understand it would be more expensive but the group should be divided by language with separate guides.

Bought ticket from any ticket booth on any street or hotel. Pick up time in very well known spots. Amazing double decker A/C bus. English Spanish speaking tour. 50 minutes easy journey. Amazing panoramic views while on the bus around the city. On foot tour with guide was quite condensed in two hours without a break in the heat of August. Then very long 4 hour free time, even with lengthy lunch break and then soft drink ice cream stop, and shopping, still was plenty of wasted time. The town is quite small. So go for half day.

Absolutely loved this trip, the schedule was pretty tight, but still have one enough free time. Our guide Arantxa was very nice and knowledgeable, her smile and positivity were very contagious. She was very attentive to everybody and always tried to avoid the crowds and the lines, so the visit was not stressful at all.
The visit to the cathedral was definitely a highlight, there were sooo many details that as a usual tourist you wouldn’t have noticed.
Highly recommended!

We had a very pleasant day with our tour guide Arantxa today. She was enthusiastic and knowledgeable and referred to our group as her family. There was just the right amount of walking and sights and time on our own to dine and take bathroom breaks. The bus was very comfortable and having our own device to hear the guide was genius. Our tour was very organized and my only complaint was a couple who was part of our group that showed little respect for historical items in the Cathedral ie sitting on tables and opening ancient wooden cabinets.

Toledo really is a unique part of Spain that should be done. Going on a full day tour was absolutely worthwhile. We had a wonderful guy to Shouldis the ins and outs of streets that you would never find yourself walking through and missing a lot of this wonderful city. Our guide had a great knowledge The city, the art, the history, the religions. We felt like we left no stone unturned. Definitely would recommend a tour.

The tour itself was good. The guide's information was very interesting. The guide was also very nice. However, it would be nice to have more time to explore on your own, unfortunately that was only possible for an hour. In the cathedral it would have been nice if you could still look around yourself after the interesting stories of the guide and not run around like a herd. In itself a nice tour but unfortunately you only see the "highlights" and that in goose step.

We enjoyed the tour of Toledo with Christina as the tour guide. She was very knowledgeable. Toledo is a beautiful town with an impressive history. The group was fairly large which presented some complexity. In the future, I will book an English only tour because so much time was spent while the guide gave the same information in Spanish and English. A single language tour would be more efficient and you would have the ability to get more information.

We had a blast! Our guide was Arantxa. She is very knowledgeable and made sure that we felt included. She also gave us great tips on where to buy Marzapan and where to eat. The bus is comfortable as well. Highly recommend this tour.

While our start time was delayed due to a mechanical problem with our bus, the time was adjusted so we still had the full day tour. Our guide was very enthusiastic and knowledgeable of the sights in Toledo. We were a group of people varying ages and she made sure to not be in a hurry to fast so that everyone was alright since most of the walking tour was up hill! After a long day of walking around the old town it was nice to travel back to Madrid in the luxury bus relaxing and not have deal with trains etc. I would highly recommend the tour but definitely wear comfy walking shoes!

The itinerary was great and everything was very convenient. My only suggestion would be smaller groups because with 27, we fell to the back pretty often and our radios stopped working. We also didn’t get a chance to get up close to see and take pictures for a lot of the sights because we were at the back and by the time the people in the front were finished we were moving on. Cristina was very nice and a great guide.

The tour guide was very knowledgeable and very personable. Audioguides were used that allowed social distancing. Everything was very punctual. Adequate free time was allowed for shopping and eating. I especially appreciated seeing the art of El Greco in the the original settings.

This tour to Toledo is a must for everyone coming to Spain. It was well organised, informative but also relaxed thanks to our guide Arantxa. The bus trip was comfortable and we also had sufficient time for lunch and shopping (although most shops around San Tomé church were closed). The trip covers the main highlights of the Toledo. Arantxa was giving us a lot of details about each place and trying accommodate everyone.

Still I think the trip could improve in the following points. There could be more information on Toledo as a center of learning and translation in middle ages following reconquista. More about Jewish history such as pogroms of 1391 and attacks in 1467 could be also helpful. The cathedral part was too detailed with a lot of religious subjects, perhaps it could be shorter. I would have liked to visit Sinagoga de Santa María de Blanca and Mezquita Christo de la Luz.

Pros: Toledo was interesting and the guide worked hard. Cons: 1. There was barely any free time to enjoy Toledo. 2. The tour was in both English and Spanish which was a big drawback. First, explaining in both languages is partly the reason that there was barely any free time to enjoy Toledo. Second, I felt as if the tour really was in Spanish and the English part was a shortened and less interesting translation of the Spanish part. 3. The explanations of the guide about the Jewish part of Toledo was mostly wrong and sloppy. The symbols explanations were wrong plus the explanation why the jews were eventually deported was that 'they became unpopular'. 4. The great inaccuracy and sloppiness in the description of the jewish part led me to believe that the other descriptions of the guide, unrelated to the jews, were also sloppy and inaccurate. 5. A girl traveling solo didn't arrive on time at the last meeting point. I told the guide that I saw the girl at a bathroom and she probably lost her way, which I was not surprised, but the guide insisted on not waiting for her and took the group to the bus. Then at the bus, the guide talked with office and waited longer for the girl, who miraculously found the bus just before we gave up about her. The guide should have waited at the meeting point where the girl would have had more chance finding us.

The area is great and tour was ok.
However, there were serious problems with the logistics.time to gather was 8:40, bus was not available until after 9:20.
If I would not know a little Spanish I would not be able to understand English in this bilingual tour.

Air conditioner on a bus was barely working on the way back. It was 40 C outside! In fact it felt cool when we got out of the bus.
May be we were just super lucky with all our previous guides in Spain. We have another tour scheduled with this company, trying to find alternative. Planning to cancel that booking.

Thankfully, I had read reviews about the size of the group (about 50) and that the same tour was in Spanish and English, so we knew what to expect. Our tour guide was great. Very enthusiastic and knowledgeable. The tour hit all of the highlights and allowed enough free time to explore a little on our own. Was definitely easier than trying to organize the day on our own. Toledo is a beautiful, history filled city. Enjoy the marzipan!

It had an amazing experience with Arantxa, very nice tour and knowledge tour guided. I will take this trip again. Out of the 4 tours this one was the best because of how nice the tour guide was and we didn't get much time to do things it was good and fun.

The synagogue was my favourite part. The sun was shining through the windows with a golden glow and it was absolutely beautiful. I came in September and it’s a really good weather, I wasn’t cold at all the whole day, but also didn’t break a sweat!

It was a descent tour. I felt like it was too many people for 1 tour guide. We had a group of 50+ people and it just didn’t flow well. The tour was in English and Spanish which made it difficult and time consuming. The guide spoke fairly quickly and was hard for me to understand. The tour was OK but I probably wouldn’t do the tour again.

Our guide, Aranxta, was amazing. She was friendly, knowledgeable and attentive to our entire group for the entire tour. She gave in depth (time allowing) descriptions of so many of the tour points that I really enjoyed. I would highly recommend her tour!

We had a wonderful experience. Our tour guide,
Arantxa, was amazing. She is extremely knowledgeable and provided a thorough tour of the area. Our tour was conducted in English and we used a radio guide to stay connected.

The tour has a lot of walking. There are hills and cobblestone streets. Be sure to wear your walking shoes. However, the walking pace is good and there are breaks to use the restroom and buy water. We covered a lot of ground and learned a lot of history in a short period of time. The tour offers a break for lunch and to explore the area.

We toured Segovia and Avila, but Toledo was hands down our favorite. There is so much to see in the City and the main cathedral was a true standout. Our tour guide Arantxa was amazing - she has a great sense of humor, engaged the group and was and very informative. All and all, highly recommended.

My tour guide was amazing. I don’t know Spanish, but the guide spoke very good English and could understand her very well. She was full on knowledge, yet was charming and funny. I definitely would recommend seeing this beautiful city.

Arantxa was a highly competent and absolutely lovely guide (whose extremely clear pronunciation meant I most often did not even need her English translation, as I had understood from the Spanish), a very beautiful city of course.

However we were horrified to find that the tour refused to collect the audioguide headsets at the end of the day, which were thus discarded. Single-use electronics is simply awful and was a major downer on the day.

What a wonderfull expirience, Toledo is really a nice place so quite and full of art a place that had to be visit. We did yesterday 25/2 ,the visit with a professional and friendly guide Oscar, we really enjoy this visit with him,he did a great job expleining all the history and secrets of this magic place and go to visit the cathedral will takes your breath away.
I really suggest this expirience to everyone!

We had a fun day. Toledo was totally worth it! Beautiful city and so much history.

We had a large tour group but we’re still able to hear the tour guide well with the headsets.

We also had the freedoms to wander off from the group when we were ready to.

Arantxa gave us such an in-depth and detailed history of Toledo and the culture there. Beyond impressed with her memory and ability to spend a whole day explaining in both Spanish and English! Couldn’t ask for a better tour guide! Toledo Israeli was a delight. So beautiful and even after a day, still so much more to be seen. Will definitely return.

Our guide Araxa was both short of amazing. Upbeat, sweet, and extremely knowledgeable about the history of Toledo, the Cathedral and all of the important art we visited. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️‘S. The bus was also first class. I would advise that you make lunch quick as 1.15 hours goes by quick. I should have grabbed a sandwich and continued to roam the old quaint streets - this would have been a better use of my time.
Randy

I really enjoyed the entire trip. It was well organized and the guides were knowledgeable and very friendly. I felt very taken care of through the entire trip.

The one improvement I would make is minor. I found it difficult sometimes to follow the guides narrative because they would occasionally jump back and forth from english to spanish in mid sentence. I would have preferred that they delivered the information in one language and then the other language so that the narrative didn't seem disjointed. However, this happened only occasionally and overall I think the whole experience was wonderful and well worth the price.

It was a great trip and we enjoyed a lot.. guide was superb and it's a must visit trip.. Telado is a beautiful blend of architecture with nature... You can spend quality time on this trip and will not regret it..

Loved the tour. It was the perfect amount of everything . We never had to stand in lines to get and in places. We had Arantxa and she was lovely. Overall really good price and super comfortable bus. The guide was very knowledgeable about the topics and did a great job translating to English.

Punctual driver, friendly tour guide, well organized day tour, lots to see. Satisfied with the tour overall. The only complaint I have is that the tour guide has such a strong accent that we had trouble understanding her, especially because the tour group mixed both languages and she constantly switched between the two languages, sometimes even every other few words.

Today we had a tour to Toledo from Madrid with Arancia (the spelling of the name may be wrong). She was absolutely fabulous. Her love and passion for what she does really showed on the tour.

The trip to and from was very comfortable. There were USB ports on the bus to charge the phone, the seats reclined, and the air conditioning was very nice.

Once we were there, she provided an excellent tour of many beautiful sights. She answered any and all questions asked about further information on the sights seen. If you are considering booking the tour, you won’t be disappointed.

This truly was an excellent tour, and gave us a great overview of the city of Toledo. Rafael was particularly a terrific English-language-guide. I very much enjoyed the experience, and while I am usually loathe to take big bus tours, this was really an exception.

Well done!

Excellent trip to Toledo. Guide very knowledgeable and managed the group and time well. We weren’t rushed at any stage and got to spend ample time at all monuments. The guide, Ceranza (please forgive bad spelling) gave us loads of info to bring the various monuments to life for us, without her info they wouldn’t have had as much impact. This was my third trip in three days with this company and all were very good.

The Toledo trip is a must do one. The Fun & Ticket manages the trip well. our guide Guias is very knowledgeable and took good care of everyone in the whole team, explaining everything in both Spanish and English. We have enough time to tour, take pictures and also enough time to take break, have lunch. Highly recommend it to all.

It was a great tour and our Guid e was very knowledgeable. One thing is that I wish the tour had been in English only. Our Guide very fluently switched back and forth between English and Spanish, but I still has some trouble following.

Toledo is an amazing city. Centuries of culture and history running through every building, street, and monument. The tour guide was priceless in providing details about every location we visited. If you’re in Madrid, this tour is an absolute must!

Very nice tour around Toledo town, visited tombs and cathedrals. Tour guide speaks in spanish followed by english, which makes it easier for tourist who don’t understand spanish. Responsible and friendly tour guide, punctual and responsible - does roll call to ensure the whole group is present.

The guide, Arantxa, was knowledgeable and efficient. It was very convenient to have the bus as well. It would have cost 28 euros just to take a train round trip to Toledo. Since this trip includes a guide and entrance fees for just a little more than that, it’s a great deal.

Oscar was our awesome guide! Not an easy job trying to translate back and forth from Spanish to English and back again. Better to have a tour in English only and Spanish only. Bus doesn't have wifi or a place to charge phone, bummer since I'm only connected to the world via wifi. Bus driver navigated the streets with ease, bravo! Toledo is beautiful, well worth the trip.
Things to improve:
Provide a map highlighted with walking route and resting stops taken on tour, since it's really easy to get lost.
Wifi on the bus
USB chargers on the bus
Map (see above) with guide's cell# for emergencies
Guide for English or Spanish, or..?
You rock Oscar!!

Toledo Spain is gorgeous and I am so glad we took a guided tour. We would have wasted a lot of time and learned so little on our own. Arantza was the perfect guide. She was so knowledgeable and passionate about the sites on our tour and she kept the history fresh- not dull facts. She was easy to understand. She was also very kind- there was a lot of walking (uphill,downhill, cobblestones) but she gave rest breaks without appearing to do so- story from history, view, architectural feature.
Well done all around!

Arantxa was a lovely guide for our day tour in Toledo. She was extremely knowledgeable about the history of the region and had such a welcoming presence. It’s evident that she loves what she does and that made us love the tour even more! We highly recommend Toledo, this company, and especially Arantxa!

Toledo is a fabulous day trip from Madrid! If you really want to get a good view of Toledo, you definitely need a full day. I can’t imagine combining it with other cities.

Our guide, Arantxa, was fabulous! Her knowledge of history and art is incredible. You will learn *a lot* if you get her for a guide. She is extremely personable and was even able to get our group in first when the cathedral opened so we had it to ourselves for a little while. Get ready to walk a lot (including up and down hills) so wear good shoes! Highly recommend!

Christina was very informative, however, I do think when waking into Toledo that she should slowdown and wait for the group to catch up. Likewise when leaving the square to return to the bus. Apart from the slight disconnection the tour was very good and I thought Christina was a very good guide. Would recommend the tour to friends. Toledo is steeped in history and has nice wine bars

Language savvy tour guide with incredible speech of language switching several times btw the language with a Spanish heavily tinged accent. Overall the magnificent town of Toledo couldn’t get across. What a pity!

Excellent tour. Our tour guide, Aranxta was very knowledgeable of what we were seeing. The group was big but still felt personable. We also had radio headphones so wasn’t difficult to listen to all the facts and info she shared which was great. Bring walking shoes, it is a long day of walking in this beautiful city.

This was our second tour with this tour company this week and did not disappoint. This time Rafael was our guide . We especially appreciated having a guided tour of the cathedral as it would have been overwhelming without a tour. We had plenty of time to see the sights and for free time in Toledo

Excellent trip indeed. We enjoy every moment of this wonderful city, seeing its bridges and river, and the amazing art in the cathedral. Walking through it's streets and seeing the very especial souvenir shops is really amazing. Raphael, our guide, was very knowledgeable and told us interesting facts about the city. I highly recommend this tour, you will never regret it!

Lovely tour through Toledo. Clean and air conditioned buses to and from Toledo. Very knowledgeable guides. Having the headsets helped as there were a lot of tourists in Toledo and it was hard to hear at times. Would recommend this service.

It was a beautiful perfect day to visit Toledo. Besides that Arantxa was phenomenal. Her ability to explain the history behind the places we visited was astounding and she manage to do so in both English and Spanish. I would highly recommend this tour.

We had the most amazing time! Our tour guide, Arantxa, was an energetic ball of energy that made the tour fun, fast paced, and entertaining. The bus accommodations were top notch, the staff friendly and welcoming, and all so very knowledgeable. Coming from the USA and being in unfamiliar settings can be daunting. They made this trip effortless. We would highly recommend!

Great trip, definitly recommend it! There are lot of small bars/ restaurants with good food and places to buy souveniers. I really loved the positive energy of the guide, making the trip worth it even at 30degrees. This is really a must see if you have some days to spend in Spain.

What an amazing city! Rich history and lots of culture. Tour is absolutely worth it. Edgar was very knowledgeable and guided the group based on the audience. Easily a must-do excursion when in Spain/Madrid!

Our guide was full of knowledge and pleasing personality. She kept the group moving but still catered for those who were unable to keep up for one reason or another. The city of Toledo was everything I was hoping for.

Arantxa was our guide and couldn’t have been more informative and friendly. She was patient, explained every stop along the tour in great detail and answered all questions. She wanted to make sure that everyone had an enjoyable time.

Highly recommend booking this tour, and especially with Arantxa if you can as well.

Excellent tour with a wonderful tour guide. We really got into the heart of Toledo. I'm really happy I didn't go with one of those tours that do three cities in one day. It was quite hot but there is a record breaking heatwave in Europe at the moment. The AC in the bus really helped!

What a wonderful journey! Magical. Oscar our guide was top-notch. Gave us all the details but also the tips how it be an efficient tourist of Toledo. What a great trip across the last 3000 years history of Spain. The city and its beautiful streets, buildings and cathedral are amazing but I can not imagine trying to do it all on your own in six hours! My 19 year old loved the tour as well. We had just the right amount of time but not too much. My feet are dying but my heart is full. Espagna I now know your soul because I’ve been to Toledo. Excellent trip -excellent guide.

Very relaxing yet full of amazing sites and information while strolling through a city full of history and beauty. We booked this last minute and so glad that we did. Our tour guide was great as well.

Always wanted to go to Toledo and this guided tour was the perfect introduction. Our guide was incredibly knowledgeable and also very friendly, she definitely added a huge amount of value. There is more to see in the city than we had time for but it was a great way to start to get to know it. Transfers were smooth and well organised.

The best experience ever. Put tour guide was so sweet and was so good at explaining the history behind everything. She was so comforting, it felt like I had known her forever. She explained the history in a very understandable way and she would translate each spanish sentence to english which was awesome. It was definitely the best tour ever!

This trip is a must if you are in Madrid. The city of Toledo is beautiful and unique, rich with history and tradition. Our guide was wonderful and at every stop she took she had a knowledgeable explanation in English and Spanish. Highly recommended.

Wonderful day trip around the beautiful city of Toledo. Visited the breathtaking cathedral, the El Greco museum, the Old Synagogue and the medieval Bridge along the way. Was time for food, a little solo exploration and shopping. The coach was very comfortable. The tour guide Arantxa was great and provided a great commentary as we strolled the beautiful old streets. I would highly recommend.

The tour manager does respond to emails if you have any questions before the tour.
Get ready to stay long in long line up early in the morning.
The tour could be separated into two different languages rather than two at the same time because listening to two different languages for 8 hours gives you headaches and difficult to understand.

Toledo was gorgeous and I hate to say this but the guide was just ok.

Oscar was extremely knowledgeable but I had a very difficult time understanding him. Also I would advise him the following: when talking about certain topics, stop in an area where everyone can see. He was great to stop under shade in extreme heat but there were a number of times where he stepped into a venue (cathedral, museum etc) and started talking about a certain part of the venue w/out everyone able to see what he was talking about. I found myself rushing toward him so as to not miss what he was talking about.

The tour is historic and full of cultural education. The tour guide was positive, energetic and knowledgeable. The only issue is that it involves a lot of walking and it is a long tour, so young kids will quickly get tired and restless.

We loved hearing about the historical background of the various sites in Toledo! The tour by Arranza was very efficient but fun! She did a wonderful job of connecting with us in the group and making sure our needs were met. Definitely recommend the full day excursion. We were able to receive a comprehensive experience of beautiful Toledo!

The guide was fantastic- super knowledgeable and very nice . Did a great job accommodating both English and Spanish speakers. Lots of walking and standing on this tour. The cathedral is absolutely amazing.

Antaxa (might have misspelled her name) was a great guide

This was a convenient getaway to experience a more historical setting within Spain. History buffs will love this. The only critical feedback is to ensure the English presentation of the material is as comprehensive as the Spanish presentation. many of the details and context in Spanish did not come through in English so next time I would look for a more English focused tour.

Had a great tour day, our guide was amazing with a great detailed knowledge of the sites we looked at.
I would really recommend this tour and this guide. Everything went smoothly. The tour pick up location is very central and easy to find. Was happy to give him a tip at the end because he really earned it.

A well run and fascinating tour of Toledo, and one of the most magnificent cathedrals in Europe. Our guide (Arantia) was outstanding, with excellent knowledge of the town, coupled with fantastic interaction skills, and a very positive attitude. She was fluent in Spanish and English.

Enjoyed the tour of Toledo wit our excellent guide for spoke in several languages. Content of tour was good but our free time was somewhat spoiled by the coach leaving 30 minutes late due what should have been foreseen road closures. So free time was very limited, reducing our shop exploring time. Met some lovely people on the coach tour. I hope your further adventures go well.

Our tour guide Oscar was incredibly knowledgeable. We learned A LOT about Toledo. There was a good mix of free time and tours of the Santo Tome Church, Synagogue of St. Mary the White, and the Cathedral of Toledo. I would recommend this tour.

Do not miss this tour!! The Cathedral is well worth it! You will be in awe. Be prepared for a lot of walking and in some places hills. If you like shopping when you get let go for lunch I suggest you eat a quick snack and not sit down for a meal because you won’t have much time.

We were looking forward to the tour, but when we showed up at 8:50am at the Main office it was closed and there was nobody. It turned out we had to be there at 8:15 and would be transported to the terminal.
Upon contacting the representative, she was very aggressive indicating that I do not know how to read! We therefore missed the tour and I think the instructions should be clearer.

Thank you Cristina you're a amazing awesome tour guide. It was a big group, 29 of us and you took care and ensure that we have fun, microphone are working well, took care of our safety too. Highly recommended. Please rember not to forget to tip your guide, they put in such effort and energy . Perfecto!

The guide maybe wasn't bad, but her English ...... Guys really you shouldn't have sold it as a trip with an English speaking guide. She was telling a lot but in Spanish ( and maybe it was very interesting as Spanish speaking pa4t of our trip seemed to be involved in her stories), in English maybe a few sentences, so a disappointment.
The funniest quote: " the charge became a mask" - this is what we got, unfortunately

Excellent trip from Madrid to Toledo. We went with our 2 year old, and had no issues with our stroller (other than having to carry the stroller a couple of time up some stairs, similar to other places in Europe). Our guide was great and really knowledgeable.

The Toledo Cathedral was amazing! Definitely the highlight of of the trip! Arantxa was an excellent, knowledgeable guide and we covered a lot of ground but still had some time for a fortifying coffee midway through the day.
