All aspects of the tour, from the escort from the main office to the bus depot, to the smooth ride to Torino, to the carefully plotted route through the city, were terrific. The headset was the only technical glitch as it didn't work consistently but our group was not large and Arantxa made it work.

Our tour guide’s spirit and energy made the trip engaging and a worthwhile experience. Favorite monuments included the Synagogue and Cathedral. The trip provided a good balance of guided tour and free time.

Very interesting tour of Toledo and its cathedrals. We spent a lot of time in the synagogue and the Cathedral of Toledo. Our guide, Aranxta, was engaging, enthusiastic, kind, and very knowledgeable. Saw a number of original paintings, too, by El Greco.

Our guide Arantxa was amazing! She was funny, kept us in the shade and was so upbeat. It was 40c/104f that day and we were dying. She went back and forth between English and Spanish easily and kept us engaged. Hard to do when your group is hot!

My complaint is with the tour company. The description of the tour says 15max. There were over 40 in our tour. Definitely not 15. And, like I said, it was a hot day and Arantxa took great pains to make sure we stayed in the shade. Imagine, getting on the bus and the A/c wasn’t working!!! Inexcusable and dangerous! A family had to strip down their baby, because she was getting overheated. 2 is elderly women were getting fanned by their kids. Everyone was dripping wet when we got out. This is like leaving a dog or a kid in a hot car. The agency should have all their buses checked.

My trip was amazing. I loved seeing this beautiful city and learning so much history at the same time. My tour guide, Narancha, was the best! She was so sweet, informative, and time efficient. I would recommend to anyone visiting the city.

An amazing day taking in so much. We really felt informed and well looked after and our guide Oscar was friendly and thoughtful. Even in the searing heat of 40 degrees, and with so many distractions along the way (there is SO much to see!) it was a really fun way to see as much as possible in the time we had. There is no way you would see or learn as much without the tour. Highly recommended!

Arantxa was our tour guide and she was excellent and paid attention to everyone in the group to make sure we all had a great time. This turned out to be my favorite tour so far in Madrid most of which is due to having the best guide. Recommend especially if you get lucky and get Arantxa as the tour guide. Be prepared to walk but it will be worth it.

Toledo is well worth checking out. The views are spectacular. The architecture is amazing, and our guide, Antonio, was incredible. He knew everything there is to know about the town, and he was fun and energetic. From the ancient histories of the Synagogue, Mosque, Church, and Cathedral, to the restaurants and shops, he knew it all. We were given just the right amount of free time and breaks to eat and explore on our own. The trip to and from Madrid was quick, easy, and comfortable. Thumbs up all around.

Highly recommend. I absolutely loved this tour, from getting on the bus ,to the historical places on this tour. I have never been so interested in history. By the end of this tour you will know the key events and places in Toledo.

The tour guide was super nice and the whole experience at Toledo was good. We felt the guide and explanation of the each site was too long. Wish it could have been more simple guide and move on to next so we have also more time for our own.

Amazing tour where everything is fitted - it’s time for beautiful views, time for walking through magic streets of Toledo, time for learning a lot about Cathedral and other interesting objects and last but not least - time for food and free activities ^^ our guide was very careful about us and has a lot of interesting stories about Toledo. Although, it’s a good option to have your own earphones for radio . We recommend it!

Excellent tour by our tour guide, Arancha. Very informative and allowed sufficient time for shopping and lunch breaks. The bus transport was comfortable, air-conditioned, and punctual. Our tour guide (Arancha) was very knowledgeable. Highly recommend!

Arantxa was such a lovely welcoming tour guide with lots of knowledge. I learnt and saw a lot about Toledo that I probably wouldn’t have without her. She spoke both English and Spanish and looked out for everyone. Would really recommend the trip - there was enough time to look around and explore independently too. Transport and tickets all organised so I didn’t have to worry about bookings. Thank you Arantxa :)

Our group enjoyed the outing to Toledo and recommend it. The group was rather large compared to other tours we took. Our tour guide was very friendly and knowledgeable. Finding the departure point in Madrid was a little confusing. Looking forward to visiting Toledo again in the future!

The day tour was perfect! Our tour guide was a great communicator and made the trip very interesting. We stuck to the schedule which was a very balanced mix of beauty, history, breaks, and food. The shuttle was also comfortable. I highly recommend this tour.

The tour was wonderful! Our tour guide (Arancha? Probably horribly misspelled) was so knowledgeable, energetic and entertaining. We saw a lot but had enough breaks that it wasn’t exhausting. A day trip on our own would not have been nearly as interesting or fun.
My only reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is that the company had to reschedule the tour. That was a problem because I was not able to reschedule the things I had planned, so had to choose one tour over another. We missed an English guided tour of the Prada and ended up with a second tour after the full day in Toledo. But I have no regrets that I chose this tour!

We had an excellent time on this tour! We had Oscar as a guide and he did a phenomenal job. He gave the tour in both English and Italian, and Spanish on request. This was a mostly guided tour with plenty of history and culture to explore. We had about an hour or so of free time to grab lunch and then another half hour at the end of the tour to shop around before leaving. The cathedral tour was amazing and highly recommended. The street walking is great but good walking shoes are a must, as is bringing an ample amount of your own water if you expect it to be warm.
Toledo is charming. Definitely worth visiting. The tour took us to the synagogue, see artwork by El Greco and visit the beautiful basilica. I think art lovers would love the tour.

Very interesting day trip to Toledo. Walking tour of Jewish area including the synagogue, visit to El Grecos famous painting and a tour of the cathedral. Our guide Victor was very interesting and clearly knew a lot about the area. We also had a bit of free time for a coffee stop and a lunch stop but otherwise quite a busy day. There is a fair amount of walking which we really enjoyed but this tour wouldn't be suitable for anyone with mobility issues.

Toledo is a great city to visit. It has many well preserved historical sites. Our guide was very good. She provided a lot of information and was very personable and energetic.
We definitely recommend this company to take the tour.

From start to finish this tour was awesome. Arantxa was patient, kind, and full of historical facts which she shared around every corner. I’d highly recommend this tour to anyone seeking a day of adventure outside Madrid. Wear comfy shoes!

Muchas Gracias María. La pasamos fenomenal en el tour. Nos encanta la manera que no mostrastes donde vives.

Thank you, the experience was amazing especially since this was my first time ever visiting Toledo, let alone Madrid.

You made the experience a thousand times better and I definitely will recommend it to my friends.

Great daytrip from Madrid to Toledo. Very informative guide (Arantxa) who had a good sense of humour, and kept a good pace of the tour. Highly recommend a full day tour so you have enough time to see the city properly.

I was a little hesitant, as I am a solo traveler and I didn’t know much about Toledo, but I’m so glad I went! It was a beautiful tour, only took half of the day which is great if you’re crunching for time, and you see so much. Our tour guide was also very knowledgeable and lovely. :) Highly recommend!! Totally worth it.

Oscar was amazing he did the entire tour in both English and Spanish. I would have loved more free time, yet wanted to follow Oscar to listen to all of the great information. Get ready for the heat, amazing views, and outstanding 🇪🇸culture.

Clear communication and attentiveness to detail was absolutely helpful. The tour was awesome and we didn’t feel rushed or bored at any point. The pace of the tour was just right for everyone in the group. I highly recommend them.

We love history and Toledo (and Spain more broadly) is rich in it, between the Romans, Visigoths, Moors, Christian, Muslims, Jews, etc., there’s so much to see and learn. There are many scenic views as well. We also loved our guide Cristina. She was smart and very personable. She brought the rich history alive with her passion for history and Toledo. Highly recommend!

City is different, cute. Currently, city is in a drought. Tour with Aranxa was great. She was bubbly and knowledgeable. She spoke both English and Spanish very fluently. I cannot express but positive things about my tour guide. The your was a bit boring. I believe tour didn't have to be so long or so much talking. I believe it needs more free time to explore on your own.

It was a very pleasant excursion to the Toledo town.Our guide Aranta was very informative and full of energy. We discovered several points of interest including majestic cathedral (Catedral Primada Santa María de Toledo).

The tour is organised very well and our guide was very friendly and knowledgeable. She highlighted all the attractions and explained their significance. Is a bit fast paced since there is a lot to cover and in a day, you can only do so much. But it was a good day trip from Madrid👍
Carlos was a great guide! It was a hot day but he paced everything well which made the heat bearable. I enjoyed his insight into the history behind the monuments. Fully recommend Carlos as a guide!

The address written on the tickets to meet at before the tour was not correct. A bus did come there but it was for another tour with a different company. No one answered when we called the phone number on the ticket to get the correct address. I feel scammed for not having the correct meet up information on the tickets. I am in the process of getting refunded.

As I wrap up my time here in Spain after taking multiple tours, I can say this was the best one. While Toledo is a wonderful place to visit, our guide made this trip special. Arantxa is a smart and passionate person, she made everyone feel at ease and really knows her stuff. She made us want to learn as much as we could. As another commenter mentioned, be prepared to walk. Thank you to all who made this trip happen and a special thanks to Arantxa.

Our tour guide, Arantxa was amazing. I loved that we started at the top of the town and walked down to the sights. It was much more enjoyable than starting at the bottom and walking to the top.
Arantxa was very knowledgeable, had good information to share with us, and her pace was good.
Arantxa was incredible how she went back and forth between English and Spanish. This was one of my favorite tours.

Our guide was great! Friendly, knowledgeable, and did well showing us as much as possible at a nice pace. The whole city might as well be a museum, there’s so much history to take in. We’ll worth the trip.

Interesting whole day walking tour of Toledo (with bus from Madrid). Happy and upbeat guide. The tour is in 2 languages - Spanish and English - which I personally did not mind, but it does slow the tour down a bit. You'll visit the most important places in Toledo (apart from Alcázar, which I had hoped we would get time to visit by ourselves). I also think there could have been a bit more historical information and background from the guide.
But overall for the price it was a great tour.

Wonderful day in Toledo! Aranxa was FANTASTIC!!!!! So professional, courteous and knowledgeable. She went out of her way to make sure we had a great experience.

She even walked us to a restaurant we couldn’t find at the beginning of our lunch time!

Tour guide was excellent. She made the English and Spanish very fluent and easy to follow. Very knowledgeable and sweet. Only problem I have is about a group of 3 that was constantly late and getting lost. Tour guide should not have made everyone wait and had to constantly look for them. We are adults and have schedules to follow. Also, bus was tight and packed with 15 people plus guide and driver, not a comfortable ride.

The city is beautiful and the tour was very pleasant. It was a Saturday so obviously there were big crowds everywhere, and even a wedding happening! The tour lady (I do not remember her name) was very knowledgeable, and she was extremely sweet with everyone. I wish they were a couple of short breaks in between but overall everything was great.

Don't be put off by the unfriendly Tour Office staff in orange t-shirt at the meeting point. Our actual tour guide was friendly, helpful, patient & very knowledgeable. A great day out. Toledo is hilly so be prepared to work your legs.

Toledo full day tour with Arantxa was an enjoyable, educational, and exciting experience!! Our group of three thoroughly enjoyed ourselves.

Arantxa is highly proficient in the history of Spain and Toledo. Together with her enthusiasm, passion, and super friendly welcoming attitude, made this for an unforgettable experience. We all are now left with big smiles, good memories, and are wiser about the history of Spain and Toledo thanks to Arantxa. The driver provided us a nice ride to and from our pick up/drop off place. The bus is modern and very comfortable.

Toledo is stunning and worth visiting. Highly recommend this tour!

Great trip, lots of history and beautiful sightings. Even on a hot day you can enjoy this beautiful city. Enlgish explanation is excellent. Be advised, due to hill climbs your feet will be sore after a 6km walk. Totally worth it though.

Our tour to Toledo exceeded expectations. Arantxa, our tour guide, was very knowledgeable and personable. I learned so much about the history and sites of Toledo in a few hours. We skipped the lines to most of the major attractions including the cathedral. There wasn’t a question we asked her that she didn’t have an in-depth, informative answer for. The tour allowed us some time to have a nice sit down lunch and shopping. I would highly recommend this tour and Arantxa as a tour guide, if possible.

Cristina so caring, the bus trip to Toledo recommendable. You have options to choose a trip woth entrance tickets or without. One more time thanks to Cristina for making even more special and to Alvaro who helped us get the tickets!

Oscar, our tour guide, was exceptional. He kept my interest the entire time. He was very knowledgeable of the history of Toledo and was very personable and approachable. I learned a lot and piqued my interest in Spanish history. Would highly recommend him and his tour company.

Oscar escorted us on several tours with Fun and Tickets. He did an excellent job. Very knowledgeable everywhere we went. Also Robert in the office was vey helpful and answered our questions and helped us get on great tours

The tour was quite good, and our guide Arantxa was a joy. She was knowledgeable, considerate, efficient, extremely personable, and kind.

Her passion and enthusiasm was clear from the start, and she took great care of her familia during all aspects of the tour. Well done!

Started out bad with not a very nice welcome. Group size was WAY to big at almost 40! Missed most of the history on the bus do to poor sound. However, once we got to Toledo Oscar was great. Very detailed tour!

Toledo is steeped in diverse culture & history and in one of the most beautiful locations. A special mention and muchas gracias to our wonderful tour guide Arantxa for leading us on a relaxed & informative journey of this charming city. A highly recommended day trip to do when so close to Madrid.

Great tour! No regrets at all. The tour guide did an amazing job translating to English and Spanish at the same time. We had an hour for lunch/souvenirs which is plenty of time. They buy your entrance tickets for you. Don't waste time with other tour agencies!

The trip to Toledo was amazing! Everything was very organized and we were able to do a lot on our trip with the group and with alone time. Cristina was an awesome tour guide, she was very helpful and knowledgeable. We learned a lot and really enjoyed the trip overall.

Guide was excellent. Her knowledge of the sites was excellent, almost too much. I was getting pretty whipped by the time we'd gotten to the cathedral. But I have to say it's worth the effort. I appreciated the free time in Toledo at the end of the your. I highly recommend this tour as an introductuon to Toledo. Please plan on returning to spend at least a couple of days. This is an amazing location withore to offer than a day tour can satiate. The tour was excellent. Well worth theoney and the time. Just plan to return.
Christina is the guide you want. She's amazing.

(Madrid to Toledo) Excellent tour! Engaging and extremely knowledgeable tour guide, catering for multiple languages fluently: Spanish, English, Italian. Great day out for all the family as some stayed with the guided tour to explore the sights whilst others went to do their own thing in Toledo. Great time management getting back to Madrid at designated time. The coach was air conditioned. Great day out!!!

Excellent tour with the delightful Arantxa. So patient and so friendly. We saw all the main highlights of Toledo with a comprehensive tour of the cathedral. Free time too. 5 star tour and highly recommended.

Our tour was great . The tour guide Aranta was extremely knowledgeable.
Her knowledge of art history was outstanding. She pointed out and explained many points that I never would have known. I recommend this trip with this guide

Excellent tour guide who have tour in both Spanish and English. She was delightful. There was quite a bit of walking but not at a fast pace and there was time for lots of pictures. Considering the size of the group she kept it very well managed. There also was time for lunch and shopping

Saw a lot of Toledo and the cathedrals were beautiful. Especially the last one we saw. I’d suggest bringing water and good walking shoes. Very hilly! Time to eat and shop a bit towards the end. Guide did a good job making sure everyone stayed together

Great trip with interesting and knowledgeable guide Cristina and Juan.
Lots of interesting facts shared. Cristina was very sympathetic to the group needs and paced the visit nicely. Great driver too and a very comfortable bus. Would definitely recommend

Went to toledo with friends. Tour guide Aranzazu was excellent, would highly recommended. Spoke excellent Spanish and English as well. Well paced, though a good amount of walking and a bit chilly. So bring good shoes and a coat.

Excellent tour. Well worth it. We had a good time. Our guide Arantxa was awesome, she was super helpful, knowledgeable and kept everybody engaged. This tour does require some walking so be ready for it. The city of Toledo is an incredible place to visit.

I highly recommend this tour.

Thank you
Covers the highlights of Toledo. Guided Tour in Spanish and English. Guide switches after one sentence to the other language. Sometimes a bit hard to follow. Little time to explore a bit of your own.

An exciting view of an ancient city! The fortress, the city walls, the history. However, surprise to find a modern town with shops, food and sites to see. A lot of walking have good comfortable shoes. Tour guide was great!

Our tour guide, Christina, was excellent. She clearly knew the history of Toledo & its historic sights. It was a an enjoyable day & we are glad we did the entire day, including the Cathedral. I appreciated the details Christina provided on the Cathedral.
Excellent experience. Easy to book, timely conducted, and polite guide. Left from Madrid in the morning 9 am and returned by 6 pm. Comfortable bus coach and good time given for food etc.

Aranxia was a very nice guide and we had an interesting tour with her. I fully recommend the tour. In my view, I wouldn’t need such a long pause at the end of the tour (1,5 hours). However, the rest of the group was at least quite happy.
Thank you Aranxia for this nice tour!

Our tour guide was very informative and was very fun! Arantxa made this trip very pleasant. She was patient and answered all our questions. The tour company changed our reservation last minute and the admission included was not doable because of COVID closures. Nonetheless it was worth it even without admission and the changes for the amount of information and experience we got. Toledo is beautiful.

Wonderful day trip to Toledo! The pace was perfect with lots packed in but plenty of time to explore on your own at lunch and a return to Madrid well in time for dinner. Toledo is a fascinating and beautiful city and Arantxa was a perfect guide. I learned a lot and enjoyed myself.

Great trip from start to finish. All the highlights of Toledo, lovely group and an excellent guide in Aranctxa who called us her “ family” and made us feel like we were . Her friendly and caring manner, expert knowledge and stewarding of the group plus allowing free time made for a brilliant day. Worth every penny. Thank you

What a wonderful caring person Aranxa is (i.think I still spell her name wrong.... perdonne me!).

I went on the Avila/Segovia tour earlier and was so happy she was also my guide for Toledo.

Highly recommended .. we did it on Oct-28th .. the cathedral is absolutely stunning .. our tour guide Aranzja was really amazing .. she made the tour such an enjoyable experience.. I just wish we have had some extra free time throughout the day.

The trip to Toledo was much better than the two days that we spent in Madrid. We did a tour of the Palace in Madrid which was really good too. Our trip to the Prado was also impressive. Our bus tour was nice, but it was difficult to understand our guide on the walking tour. I did not intend to imply that you should skip Madrid. I just don’t want you to miss Toledo! We also loved going to Seville, Cordoba and Granada. If I were going to go back to Spain, I definitely would skip Barcelona!

Great tour. Our tour guide Esperanza was amazing and our bus driver Carlos made sure we get there safely. She explained a lot in detail. Such a bubbly and happy person. Made my Toledo experience memorable. I’ll be recommending them to more of my friends and will be booking more tours with them when I go back to Spain. Muchas Gracias!

Toledo is a must see and Oscar was a wonderful guide. He was extremely knowledgeable and friendly. The tour moved pretty quickly but was just enough time to see the major sites. Would recommend this tour for everyone.

Perfect mix of organised sightseeing and time to wander on own. Guide Arantxa was excellent. Knowledgeable, funny and did one sentence in Spanish then English and so on. So no waiting around not knowing what was going on. Beautiful city.

This was a very lovely experience for someone who is new to Europe. We crossed a lot of historical architecture that was amazing to see and the view of this tour was phenomenal. Highly recommend if visiting Spain for first time.

Well organized. Our guide was informative and very friendly. The bus ride was comfortable and clean. The cathedral is truly spectacular and was the highlight of the tour. Arrived back in Madrid at 5 pm so still had plenty of time to relax/explore.

Really amazing tour, I would recommend to everyone to come see Toledo with Arantxa. She explained everything to us about the history and the different take overs of Toledo. She’s super flexible when the group needs anything and makes it so nice and easy.

It was a wonderful tour. Oscar was a great guide and provided commentary throughout. We were prompt and on time from start to finish. I saw other tour guides from other companies that weren’t speaking nearly as much as Oscar did so it was clear that he was interested in sharing as much knowledge as possible.

Very informative trip. Oscar our guide was very good. He alternated between English & Spanish well for all to understand. During our walking tour we were given headphones so we could still hear him without issues, even when if we fell back a few yards. The walking tour with all the stops & information shared is a must, to experience Toledo properly. Overall, very good tour plus the bus was very nice, clean & updated.

Rafael was excellent in guiding our tour. He is very nice and knowledgeable in history and culture. We enjoyed the tour because of him. The bus was fully air conditioned and comfortable ride. I booked the rest of the week through them.

Very beautiful city and very nice guide. Cathedral was most beautiful part of the trip.
Tips: If you came on the summer then is good to have a spray against fly.
Thanks to guide for her energy and enthusiasm regarding city of Toledo.
Our tour guide was absolutely wonderful! She really brought the city alive taking us back in history. We hit all the best points in the city. Highly recommend. This tour is definitely worth it

I took two tours with Fun and Tickets during my 5 day visit to Madrid, and I highly recommend them both. You cannot beat the value, especially if you calculate the cost of taking alternative transportation options independently and without a tour guide or included admission. You depart from a convenient, central location off the Gran Via in central Madrid that is easily accessible from the city center. The buses provided were large, clean, and spacious, and there was plenty of room to comfortably spread out. Our tour guide, Aranxa, was both very well-versed in not only the history of Toledo, but also giving our group a sense of the culture and vibe of the city, pointing out details like local delicacies and local crafts in store windows as we walked the main street. The tour did deviate from the itinerary advertised on TripAdvisor due to weekly scheduled closures at individual venues - Santo Tome church was closed for the day, and instead of visiting the Synagogue of St. Mary the White, we instead visited the Transito Synagogue. However, Santo Tome was substituted for the El Greco museum (which I was honestly very happy with and would pick if I had a choice), and the Transito was just as interesting and provided just as much an immersion in the history of Toledo's Jewish community. The Cathedral was the highlight and took a considerable amount of time to take in given the size and history, and by the time we were done and ready for lunch it was almost 3pm, so perhaps bring a snack or eat a heavy breakfast before leaving for the tour. We did have time to both eat lunch and explore the city on our own as well. The tour guide was very, very patient in her narration, alternating between Spanish and English at every site, and sharing the exact same information (I'm bilingual). You will be provided with an individual bluetooth headset so that you can hear and enjoy her narration without distraction and at your preferred volume. If you have the time during your visit to Madrid, do not hesitate to experience this opportunity.
